mutants.label: [control] reason uses __qualname__ instead of __name__
mutants.why: __qualname__ differs from __name__ only for nested classes; every exception this clause can see (http.client.*, OSError and its builtin/ssl subclasses) is a module-level class, so both give the same string on every path the suite reaches. Would differ for a nested exception class, which none of these are.
